name: chunk-conflicting-tool-name-fatal
description: a continuation chunk renaming the call its opener established is fatal, not a late correction
kill: make chunk expansion overwrite the open call's toolCallName with a continuation's value instead of rejecting the disagreement

expect.errorContains: does not match the open stream's toolCallName

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. With no chunk stage there is no open stream to conflict with, so the stream is accepted instead of rejected.
